summary: The parent mutates String storage before validating UTF-8, potentially leaving invalid contents after an error or panic. The fix moves the bytes into a separate Vec and restores the String only after successful UTF-8 validation. Blocked: the added test encoding::test::string_merge_failure supplies an unterminated length varint (\x80\x80), which returns an error before appending bytes; its initially empty string therefore remains empty in both implementations. No detecting upstream test was identified. Additionally, restoring the original implementation requires restoring the std::str import; a single contiguous region covering both changes would include intervening test code, violating the region constraint. No builds or tests were run.
